messages:
Alex: quick sync — proposing two new runtime metrics for GPU pools: SM occupancy (%) and SM queue depth. Need input on naming, tags, sampling, and where to route them (hosted vs dedicated). cc @Priya @Jon @Maria :wave:
Priya: +1 on both metrics. We can emit from the runtime at the scheduler boundary. prefer per-GPU granularity with tags: pool_type, pool_id, host, gpu_index. worried about cardinality if we include model_id/tenant_id for hosted.
Jon: ingest perspective: agree on a dedicated topic (e.g. kafka topic `gpu.telemetry.sm`). We'll want a compact proto and to batch messages to reduce EPS. What's expected EPS per pool?
Sam: for dashboards we want: headroom heatmap by pool_id, time-series (median/p95) occupancy, distribution histogram for queue_depth. also need cost tags or plan_tier for routing to Hosted vs Dedicated panels.
Maria: SRE needs alerting guidance. Suggest 5m p95 occupancy > 90% -> page, and queue_depth sustained > 50 for 1m -> page. Dedicated pools should have separate SLA dashboards. Also add a runbook link when we wire alerts.
Priya: sampling idea — emit full per-request samples only when queue_depth > 0 or occupancy > 75% to cut noise. Otherwise emit 1m aggregated counters (sum, count, max). Keeps cardinality low.
Alex: draft metric names: `redwood.gpu.sm.occupancy_pct` and `redwood.gpu.sm.queue_depth`. tags: pool_type:(hosted|dedicated), pool_id, host, gpu_index, zone. tenant_id as opt tag for dedicated (not for hosted metrics to avoid PII/high-card). thoughts? :thinking:
Jon: agree on names. proto sketch below — keeps it compact:
```proto
message GpuSmTelemetry {
  uint64 ts = 1;
  string pool_id = 2;
  string pool_type = 3; // hosted|dedicated
  string host = 4;
  uint32 gpu_index = 5;
  float occupancy_pct = 6;
  uint32 queue_depth = 7;
  uint32 sample_count = 8; // for aggregated samples
}
```
Priya: looks good. We'll add `aggregation_level` enum (raw/1m/5m) in the next pass. Also we can add `emit_condition` for on-demand samples (e.g., queue_depth>0).
telemetry-bot: ingest quota note — default topic quota is 1200 EPS per cluster; if runtime wants higher for Dedicated we need a quota request ticket. :robot_face:
Maria: action items: create runbook stub, add alert thresholds to paging config, and coordinate test alert on staging. Who owns alerts?
Alex: owners proposal: eng-runtime (Priya) = emitter, eng-infra (Jon) = ingestion & schema, eng-platform = dashboard & console integration (me), eng-sre (Maria) = alerting/runbook, analytics (Sam) = dashboard design. I'll file the umbrella ticket and split sub-tasks.
Sam: can you include expected cardinality and example queries for the dashboards? I can mock panels once we have proto.
Jon: will spin up proto + kafka topic PR. also will add a consumer config that downsamples to 1m aggregates for the metrics DB.
Priya: i'll implement emit condition and opt-in tenant_id for dedicated pools. plan to send a staging payload by EOD tomorrow.
Alex: perfect. I'll open tickets: telemetry schema, infra quota request, dashboard mocks, runbook + alerts. tagging this thread as the cross-team sync. reactions: :+1: from most, will follow up with links in the umbrella ticket.
Maria: +1. please @eng-oncall when staging alert test is ready.
telemetry-bot: ingestion pipeline status: no blocking schema conflicts expected. will post validation results to the ticket once PRs exist.
Alex: thanks everyone — wrapping up. I'll post the ticket links and assign owners.
